data.name: Nordic Offset
data.description: Nordic Offset (Nordic Offset Oy) is a Finnish carbon footprint management consultancy and voluntary carbon credit retailer, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Helsinki. It resells certified third-party credits (Gold Standard, Verra, Puro.earth) and offers emission calculation and sustainability (ESG/CSRD) reporting services. The firm has broadened into ESG reporting under the related Nordic Impact brand.
